subject: Can't edit event capacity
message: We're trying to raise our event capacity from 200 to 350 but the field won't save. Can someone check?

subject: Request: add 3 more admins
message: We need to invite 3 additional Organizer Team Members to manage our upcoming mid-year town hall. Could you increase our seat limit or resend the invitation links?

subject: Invoice discrepancy
message: Our June monthly invoice includes charges for 450 attendees, but our check-in list shows only 380 attended. Please clarify how attendee fees were calculated for EVT-2026-088.

responses.text: Hello Northwind team, as per the BRD, billing is based on total registered attendees rather than physical check-ins. We are reviewing your registration logs now.

subject: Reactivate account
message: Our account was temporarily suspended due to an overdue offline invoice payment. The bank transfer has been completed on our end. Please reactivate our account.

responses.text: Payment verified via bank transfer receipt. Your account status has been restored to Active.

subject: Dietary requirements export failing
message: We need to send the catering list to our vendor today, but exporting attendee dietary restrictions to CSV yields a blank file.

subject: Digital business cards not syncing
message: Attendees at Session B reported that exchanging digital business cards via mobile web browsers is timing out.

responses.text: We are investigating potential websocket congestion during peak conference hours.

subject: Onboarding review pending
message: We completed our company sign-up 48 hours ago. Could someone review and approve our Organizer account so we can publish our event page?

subject: Live poll results not updating
message: During the Keynote session, the live poll screen stayed at 0 votes even though attendees submitted responses.

responses.text: Resolved. Cached session tokens were preventing auto-refresh on the presenter dashboard.

subject: Check-in QR code scanning issue
message: Check-in staff devices were unable to scan attendee confirmation emails under low lighting conditions.

responses.text: Advised staff to utilize manual search by attendee name or email as fallback.

subject: Request event duplication feature assistance
message: We want to clone last year's annual conference setup including tracks and session speakers for our 2026 conference.

responses.text: Guided the user through the 'Duplicate Event' feature under Event Settings.
